texts.text: <color=#cf0000>Desire. And to the measure of your desire, тратит все.</color>
<color=#cf0000>Don yourself with все. Devour without restraint.</color>
<color=#cf0000>Desiderate. And to the measure of your desideration, deplete все.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>Though thou canst sate thyself, thou shalt not. Though thou canst indulge, thou shalt refrain.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>Thou shalt refrain from excess. Thou shalt abide на the commandments of order.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>Thou shalt not defy the rules. Every moment of thy suffering is etched в и remembered на Sisyphe itself.</color>
